chapter_title_en: The Promise of the Seven Empyrean Gods
chapter_seo_title: The Seven Empyrean Gods’ Pact: Ji Ning Gets One Chance | Desolate Era
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning learns the true history of the Starseizing Manor, meets Nuwa’s legacy, and secures a one-time intervention from seven Empyrean Gods. Volume ends with a tearful reunion with Yu Wei.
og_title: The Seven Empyrean Gods Make Ji Ning a Promise
og_description: A single call for help, one all-out intervention, and then they stand aside. Ji Ning accepts the terms with a calm Dao-heart.
twitter_title: Ji Ning Gets One Free Save from Seven Gods
twitter_description: Volume ends on a lore bomb and a quiet reunion with Yu Wei. The seven Empyrean Gods grant Ji Ning one chance—use it or lose it.

lore_anchors.definition: A high-level Fiendgod Body Refiner, one step below an Empyrean God; possesses tremendous physical power and regenerative abilities.
The ancient faction founded by Daoist Threelives, a gathering of powerful Fiendgods under one banner in the Primordial Pangu World.
A full-sized major world opened within the aquatic mansion treasure by Mother Nuwa, serving as a retreat for Threelives’s followers after the Primordial War.

The eternally dark, storm-ravaged void between the Three Realms and the broader Chaosverse; it is featureless, devoid of Dao resonance, and forces cultivators to rely solely on physical arts and Heartforce for survival.
A spiritual trial during cultivation breakthroughs that tests a cultivator’s emotional and mental weaknesses; failure can lead to madness or death.
